column1: # What each loader says of a spec: one table for the course (Source/tests/testdata/spec_verdicts.tsv and the files of
# spec_verdicts/) and the product (testdata/spec_verdicts.tsv and testdata/spec_verdicts/ at its root), byte for byte.
# Owner: «Паритет». Cases: the fourteenth review's (РЕВЬЮ-SERVERVMS-14/probes/loader); verdicts: «Архитектор»,
# 2026-10-06. A loader that answers otherwise is a red test, not a finding of the next review.
#   a spec is YAML 1.2 core, a subset: one document, a mapping; no anchors, aliases or tags; no duplicate key at any
#   level; indentation by spaces; UTF-8, no BOM, no NUL; On/Off/Yes/No are words, not booleans; integers within 2^53
#   every key known at every level (ADR-0012); every field a key names is a field of `fields:` (group_by, spread_by,
#   requests.key, snapshot, display.*); display.fields and display.options name fields, not the platform's keys;
#   display words are strings, and the tree's words a closed set
#   lease.unconfirmed_max: forever, off, or a whole number of seconds above 0 — nothing else, no empty lease:
#   requests.stamp: [group] only with placement.group_by; a key template's braces closed
#   a JSON default or inherit of a `json` field is any JSON value
# Not here: what needs the whole catalogue (worker.requests naming a subsystem with no requests: — KnowSpecs), and
# sizes (a 10 MB spec; a depth limit is here, deep_flow_200 and deeper).
# Columns, tab-separated; a line that begins with '#' and an empty line are no row:
#   case     the file spec_verdicts/<case>.subsystem.yaml beside this table, loaded alone as a subsystem's spec
#   verdict  ok — it loads; refused — the loader refuses it, with a message naming where
